# Preparation failures are atomic: the target never starts.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp malformed-fixture malformed.env
exec dd if=/dev/zero of=oversize.txt bs=65537 count=1
exec sh -c 'printf "VALUE=\"a\000b\"\n" > nul.env'
exec sesam add raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt nul.env
rm raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt nul.env

! exec sesam run --env-file malformed.env -- touch started-malformed
stderr 'invalid byte in unquoted value'
! exists started-malformed
! exists malformed.env

! exec sesam run --secret LARGE=oversize.txt -- touch started-oversize
stderr 'exceeds 65536 bytes'
! exists started-oversize
! exists oversize.txt

# os/exec rejects NUL-containing environment values before starting the target.
! exec sesam run --env-file nul.env -- touch started-nul
stderr 'exec command.*environment variable contains NUL'
! exists started-nul
! exists nul.env

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- command-that-does-not-exist
stderr 'find command.*using inherited PATH'

exec chmod +x bad-exec
! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- ./bad-exec
stderr 'exec command.*exec format error'
exec sesam id
stdout '^admin$'

! exec sesam run -- touch started-no-selector
stderr 'at least one .*--all is required'
! exists started-no-selector

! exec sesam run --secret =raw.txt -- touch started-invalid-mapping
stderr 'must be path or VARIABLE=path'
! exists started-invalid-mapping

! exec sesam run --secret BAD-NAME=raw.txt -- touch started-invalid-name
stderr 'invalid secret variable name'
! exists started-invalid-name

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --
stderr 'a command is required after --'

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt touch started-no-separator
stderr 'a command is required after --'
! exists started-no-separator

# Inherited names are never overwritten.
env RAW=parent
! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-collision
stderr 'RAW.*collides with inherited environment'
! exists started-collision

-- raw-fixture --
raw
-- malformed-fixture --
GOOD=value
BAD=two words
-- bad-exec --
not an executable format
